ai_importance.doc: How highly the AI prioritises enacting this decision; a factor around 400 appears to be high priority.

ai_will_do.doc: AI instructions for when to use the decision; optional.

allow.doc: Conditions for the decision to be enactable once visible; the green tick in the UI.

color.doc: Changes the color used in the decision tab

do_not_core.doc: The AI will not try to core this province if the decision is available, meant to prevent them from using monarch power coring provinces that will get cored or given away to another country.

do_not_integrate.doc: The AI will not try to integrate this country if the decision is available, meant to prevent them from using diplomatic power integrating countries that will get annexed or changed.

effect.doc: Effects executed immediately after the decision is enacted.

potential.doc: Conditions for the decision to be visible in the decisions panel; even the AI cannot use it when they are unmet.

provinces_to_highlight.doc: Customizes highlighted provinces to supplement the Allow section and fill missing tooltips.

factor.doc: Base weight multiplier in the enclosing weight/AI block.

country_decisions.doc: Wrapper block containing all country decision instances.
